comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null and empty-list rules. Feature 0 requires a specific functioning institutional precedent: a concrete existing law, policy, court or system that operates or has operated in practice. Feature 1 requires any specific empirical evidence: statistics, studies, data or documented cases. These are different constructs. A comment that cites a precedent need not give data, and a comment that gives statistics need not cite an institution. The institutional-precedent feature is a narrower subtype that only partly overlaps with the evidence feature.
